title.zh: 美联储威廉姆斯：今年可能再加息一次，明年无需进一步加息
title.en: 美联储威廉姆斯：今年可能再加息一次，明年无需进一步加息

current_state.zh: New York Fed President John Williams said one more rate hike this year would be appropriate but that no further hikes may be needed in 2027, citing energy prices and AI infrastructure investment as inflation drivers.
current_state.en: New York Fed President John Williams said one more rate hike this year would be appropriate but that no further hikes may be needed in 2027, citing energy prices and AI infrastructure investment as inflation drivers.
